title: Intrinsic semistable reduction loci for the iterations of non-archimedean quadratic rational functions and moduli-theoretic applications
summary: We study the intrinsic semistable reduction loci for the iterations of quadratic rational functions over algebraically closed complete non-archimedean fields. Using a reduction-theoretic slope formula for the hyperbolic resultant function and the non-archimedean argument principle, we establish a precise eventual stationarity theorem when the residue characteristic is different from $2$.
